name: asbuilt
description: Check what your website actually does: turn your intent into approved checks and get Pass, Fail or Not verified with screenshots on every pull request.

interface.longDescription: AsBuilt checks whether your website does what you meant to build. Describe the feature in plain words; your assistant drafts checks for you to approve, and AsBuilt opens the real site and reports each one as Pass, Fail or Not verified, with screenshots. GitHub mode adds a free GitHub Action that runs your approved checks on every preview deployment and posts one clear pull request comment with a fix prompt. Local mode runs the same checks from your computer. Free and open source. No account, no hosted service, no telemetry. Installing the plugin never starts a test, and nothing is committed without your permission.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use AsBuilt to turn my intended website behavior into checks. Show me the target and plan before running anything.
